ryan_support: Escalation from Acme — their A/B dashboard for experiment exp_2026_signup_cta_v2 is showing totals flipped. Dashboard: 60/40 (A/B). Assignment ledger raw shows 40/60. They attached a screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/ctaswap.png

maria_oncall: thanks for flagging. can you paste 2-3 example user_ids and the exact experiment id so we can repro?

ryan_support: experiment_id=exp_2026_signup_cta_v2. sample user_ids from customer: 84219, 13902, 00455. Query we ran against ledger: 
```
SELECT user_id, assigned_variant FROM assignment_ledger
WHERE experiment_id='exp_2026_signup_cta_v2'
AND user_id IN ('84219','13902','00455');
-- results: 84219 -> B, 13902 -> A, 00455 -> B
```

kevin_eng: pinging infra/ingest. any recent changes to cohort/variant key normalization? last rollout touched rollout-service at 1749876000 per deploy notes.

deploy-bot: deploy started by kevin_eng at 1749876000: rollout-service@v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2

kevin_eng: looking at ingestion logs — I see a normalization step that trims trailing token after a dot. so keys like `cta_A.v2` became `cta_A`. ledger still stores original `cta_A.v2` but dashboard rollups join on normalized key `cta_A`. that can cause assignments to be counted under the wrong label if older experiments used `cta_A` vs new `cta_A.v2`.

selina_analytics: that'd explain the 60/40 vs 40/60. dashboard rollup uses normalized_key join. ledger uses canonical_key. short repro: compare ledger counts vs dashboard aggregate.

kevin_eng: SQL to reproduce quickly:
```
-- ledger counts
SELECT assigned_variant, count(*) FROM assignment_ledger
WHERE experiment_id='exp_2026_signup_cta_v2' GROUP BY 1;
-- dashboard agg
SELECT variant_label, sum(assign_count) FROM dashboard_rollup
WHERE experiment_tag='signup_cta_v2' GROUP BY 1;
```

maria_oncall: can we fix customer-facing numbers fast? short-term: re-run rollup for that experiment using ledger canonical keys. long-term: stop trimming suffix or store normalized_key in ledger.

kevin_eng: agree. I'll kick a targeted re-aggregation for exp_2026_signup_cta_v2 and open a PR to change normalization. PR: https://git.redwood/rollout/PR-1234 (will keep suffix intact).

ryan_support: customer asks for ETA and reconciliation steps to confirm once fixed.

kevin_eng: kicked re-aggregation job at 1749876600. ETA ~6m. I'll post job output here when done.

deploy-bot: rollup-job started at 1749876600: job-id rollup_2026_1749876600

deploy-bot: rollup-job completed at 1749876889: status=success, rows_reprocessed=12345, affected_experiments=1

kevin_eng: re-aggregated results: dashboard now matches assignment_ledger for exp_2026_signup_cta_v2. counts show 40/60 as in ledger. Verified sample user_ids reconcile. Sending reconciliation report to support. Long-term fix: PR will remove suffix-trimming and add unit tests.

ryan_support: thanks everyone — sending update to Acme and closing the loop. will follow up on PR timeline. :thumbsup:
